name: kickoff_outcome_close_contested_win
description: 1v1 along the kickoff axis: blue starts at (0,-1200), orange at (0,1400), both boost straight at the ball. Blue touches first (frame 17) and orange touches on the next frames, so the ball pops up near the centre (frame 48, the payout: y = -208, vy = -142, in the air). Blue = field 0.4*(-208/2500) = -0.033 + possession 0 (the latest touch step had BOTH teams on it) + momentum 0.15*(-142/2300) = -0.009 + first touch 0.15 = +0.107; orange = -0.107 (+1.3 / -1.3 at weight 12). HISTORY (fixed 2026-11-03): possession followed the engine's last-touch id, the higher player index (orange), so the same race scored blue -0.093. Verified independently: the formula re-evaluated by a separate script on the ball state and touches read from the exported run reproduces the reward to 5 digits.

expect.intent: blue won the arrival race and the scrap is level: +0.107
orange is paid the exact opposite: 1v1 is antisymmetric (zero-sum)
